one_liner: Salesforce B2C Commerce exposes broad REST APIs (SCAPI/OCAPI) with OAuth2 API clients, but requires an existing paid B2C Commerce instance, so there is no self-serve path.
auth_notes: Account Manager API clients (client ID/secret) obtain OAuth scoped tokens (JWT bearer). Shopper APIs use SLAS tokens. Public clients use PKCE. Per-customer setup is needed because each merchant creates its own API client, tenant ID and short code.
access_notes: The API is free for B2C Commerce customers, but you need a B2C Commerce instance, which is obtained through Salesforce sales. No free self-serve developer sandbox is shown in the evidence. The only access evidence is a third-party guide, so confidence is medium-low.
blocker_notes: Credentials require a B2C Commerce realm and instance from Salesforce sales or an existing customer. Each customer must set up its own Account Manager API client.

evidence.quote: The B2C Commerce API (SCAPI) is a set of RESTful APIs for building storefronts, merchant tools, and integrations on the B2C Commerce platform.
Both the Admin and Shopper APIs are authorized using an access token in the form of a [JSON Web Token](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JSON_Web_Token) (JWT).
To use the SCAPI Admin APIs, you (or someone with administrator access) must first create an API client by following these steps:
Public**: Suitable for environments where a secret cannot be hidden, such as single-page web apps or native mobile and desktop applications. Uses Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE)
Contact Salesforce sales or your account representative to request access to B2C Commerce.
For B2C Commerce customers, the API is available at no extra cost.
The B2C Commerce MCP Service is a fully-hosted service for linking an AI agent to real-time B2C Commerce data access.
